description: This file defines the UserAPI class for the OrangeHRM system, providing REST API endpoints for managing User entities in the administrative context. It includes methods for CRUD operations, validation rules, parameter handling, and integration with underlying services and models.

classes.name: UserAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for User management including CRUD operations, validation, and integration with services and models within the OrangeHRM admin API module.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single User by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all users with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: setUserParams
methods.description: Populates User entity with request parameters, optionally including password.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing User by ID, optionally changing the password.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing users.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a user.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for user creation/update request body.

methods.name: getUserCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Configures unique property validation options for username uniqueness.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating User entity and saving changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more Users by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting users.
